preconditions: Reverify exact project and organization identity
Review project and organization platform webhooks: listing currently returns HTTP 403
No existing Auth users and no external providers/hooks/SMTP credentials
No deployment, messages, user creation or migration authorized by this plan
effects: Disables signup and every external authentication provider, including email/password, for the first no-side-effect smoke phase
Keeps redirect allowlist empty because no redirect flow is enabled
Does not modify secrets or enable providers
limitations: Password login will intentionally be unavailable until a separately approved no-delivery Auth acceptance configuration exists
Absence of custom SMTP does not disable the built-in Supabase mail service
This plan does not deploy a mail hook or provision a mail service
verification: No signup, recovery, invitation or email send as a verification method
